Class WaitingForPlayersPhase

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.model.phase.WaitingForPlayersPhase
All Implemented Interfaces:
GamePhase
public class WaitingForPlayersPhase extends Object implements GamePhase
The initial state of the game, representing the lobby gathering phase.

During this phase, the game accepts new players until the required capacity is reached. Upon reaching capacity, this phase takes the responsibility of initializing the game board (via the BoardBuilder) and transitioning the game state to the first active playing phase (PlaceTotemPhase).

      public void addPlayer(PlayerContext playerContext, Game game, String playerNickname)
      Registers a new player to the game and assigns them a unique totem.

      If the addition of this player satisfies the required player count, the game board is automatically generated, the initial setup is performed, and the game transitions to the PlaceTotemPhase.

      Specified by:
